summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers and per-function string-dictionary decoders that hide constants including the Bun release URL, `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, and `bun`. When invoked, `setup.mjs` checks for a `bun` binary on PATH; if absent it downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes that Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated file (string-array-rotation obfuscator with a ~1500-entry mixed hex/char-code constant table and a char-code-lookup decoder, tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`), is not declared in the package's `files` field, is undocumented, and its name bears no relation to the package's advertised monorepo-config purpose. The overall shape — install-time dispatch of an undeclared obfuscated payload through a freshly-fetched alternate JavaScript runtime — evades Node-based inspection of what actually executes on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
